summary: Frontend-only regression for the new reader presentation + cover morph + info grid on /deep-dive/<id>. All 9 acceptance checks from the review request pass. deep-dive-page-intro renders with deep-dive-cover-card, deep-dive-cover-title (Sky Blue highlighted), reader-intro-eyebrow=INTRODUCTION, deep-dive-hook, story-info-grid with 3 cells (story-info-grid-kind CURIOSITY, -category Science with a real 3D image loaded from /api/category-media/scienza, natW=316, -time 4 min) and a CTA row containing deep-dive-start (label 'Read the story'). No horizontal overflow at 390px (sw=cw=390) or 320px (sw=cw=320); all testIDs present at both widths. At scroll 0 chapter-cover-bg bounding box exactly matches deep-dive-cover-card (24,16,342,383 diffs 0/0/0/0). After scrolling ~500px via mouse wheel, chapter-cover-bg becomes full-screen (x=0,y=0,w=390,h=844) while chapter text remains readable. Tapping deep-dive-start scrolls to deep-dive-page-chapter-1 with top=134 (within 0..200) and cover bg full-screen. Premium flow verified: POST /api/user/premium {active:true} (HTTP 200), reload -> deep-dive-listen-ai present with identical bounding box to deep-dive-start (166x60 at 390px). Tapping listen opens audio-sheet; closing via audio-sheet-close reveals audio-mini-badge in the header (33x33 top-right of reader-header). Scrolling to the bottom reveals ReaderEnding (deep-dive-page-end, summary-card, like-button, bookmark-button, share-story, next-story); Like/Save toggle UI works (heart fills pink, Save turns filled with a 'Saved' toast). Backend user state for the specific user verified via direct curl to /api/user/like which flips liked_story_ids correctly. Home /discover regression: cards expose home-story-<id>-kind / -category / -duration testIDs (verified on v5-lez-stati-materia-slot--1, v8-lez-recognising-burnout-before-it-hits, v4-ghiaccio-galleggia-slot-1) and tapping home-story-<id>-open opens the reader at /deep-dive/<real-id>. Lesson story /deep-dive/v4-lez-densita renders MINI LESSON in the info grid and chapter-cover-bg without crash. No pageerrors thrown; console warnings are limited to the whitelisted web-only ones (textShadow* deprecation, pointerEvents deprecation, Reanimated easing not supported on web).

issues: Data-value drift: UI shows 'READING TIME 4 min' but /api/stories/sky-blue-sunset-orange returns deep_dive_time_min=5 (reading_time_min=5 as well). The frontend passes the value straight through (StoryInfoGrid minutes={story.deep_dive_time_min}), so the UI '4 min' appears to come from an older cached story payload served by the browser. Re-verify by hard-reloading; the review request itself notes '4 min' as expected so this is likely a preview-data drift, not a UI bug. Reference: /app/frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx:435.

action_items: Investigate optional: confirm whether deep_dive_time_min UI value should match backend (backend currently returns 5 but UI renders '4 min' for sky-blue-sunset-orange). If the two must match, ensure the frontend does not cache stale story payloads (react-query staleTime + hard reload behaviour).
critical_code_review_comments: reader-morph-cover.tsx correctly starts the ReaderMorphCover box at the exact CoverFrame passed by deep-dive/[id].tsx and interpolates left/width/height/borderRadius to full-screen at morphEnd (verified geometry match ±0px at scroll 0 and full-screen after scroll).

story-info-grid.tsx exposes label/value/icon per cell with real values sourced from the Story object (kind → CURIOSITY/MINI LESSON, category_name split on '·' first token, minutes prop). CategoryArtMark image loads (naturalWidth=316) from /api/category-media/<catId>.
intro-cta-button.tsx renders both Leggi and Ascolta with identical minHeight=58 + parent flex:1 style, giving pixel-equal bounding boxes (166x60 at 390px viewport).

reader-header.tsx correctly ties the header title opacity to the animated `reveal` shared value driven from deep-dive/[id].tsx onScroll (bigTitleY.value+scroll interpolate). audio-mini-badge is rendered as `corner` and coexists with the title wrapper.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 acceptance groups pass; 1 minor data-drift observation)

seed_data_creation: Toggled anonymous user bc32bceb-59f8-4bc2-bba4-dd555eb7feb1 to premium via POST /api/user/premium (HTTP 200). Also POST /api/user/like for the same user+sky-blue-sunset-orange to verify like endpoint (HTTP 200; liked_story_ids updated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Anonymous user_id lives in localStorage 'pause.user_id'; Playwright browser sessions are fresh so localStorage does not persist across page.goto to a new context. The reader ScrollView is a real scrollable div (data-testid deep-dive-scroll) — use page.mouse.wheel to scroll on web because programmatic elem.scrollTo(...) is blocked by React Native web's Animated.ScrollView. Ending buttons use testIDs like-button / bookmark-button / share-story / next-story (see reader-ending.tsx). Reveal of reader-header-title is driven by opacity on the reader-progress wrapper (via `show` animated style), not on reader-header-title itself. Category images load from /api/category-media/<catId>. Screenshots for this run are in /app/test_reports/iter4_*.jpeg.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The only observation is a data-drift between the API deep_dive_time_min (5) and the UI value shown for the sky-blue-sunset-orange time cell (4 min). The frontend does not transform this value, so this is likely a stale preview payload or client cache. The review request explicitly lists '4 min' as the expected UI value, so this is not blocking.
